gr-xendit-7731687003.d:
Xendit is an enterprise payments platform powering complex financial operations across Southeast Asia and global markets. We provide a unified API layer combining payment processing, global payouts, localized FX, identity compliance, and fraud protection. As a trusted financial partner backed by top-tier global investors, Xendit processes high-throughput transaction flows for leading global platforms including Meta, Traveloka, ByteDance, Wise, and Grab, building resilient payment infrastructure to drive regional commerce forward.

About the Job

At Xendit, we are looking for a mid-level/senior-level IT GRC Analyst to sit at the intersection of technology, compliance, and risk — not just for Indonesia, but across all of Xendit's operating markets. As an individual contributor, you will be responsible for ensuring our IT systems, processes, and controls meet the regulatory obligations and certification standards of every jurisdiction we operate in. You will be our regional GRC go-to person, coordinating directly with regulatory bodies across the regions (Bank Indonesia / OJK, BSP, BOT, etc). Beyond regulatory compliance, you will own and drive the full lifecycle of our IT certifications such as PCI-DSS and ISO 27001. You will work closely with engineering, security, product, and legal teams to embed compliance into how we build and operate. This is a role for someone who is detail-oriented, thrives in multi-market complexity, and can translate a wide range of regulatory requirements into practical, actionable controls in a fast-moving fintech environment.

Minimum Qualifications

• 3–5 years of hands-on experience in IT GRC, IT Risk Management, or IT Compliance roles
• Solid working knowledge of PCI-DSS, ISO 27001 frameworks, including implementation, certification, and audit readiness
• Familiarity with Bank Indonesia (BI) and OJK IT governance regulations applicable to payment service providers in Indonesia
• Exposure to or willingness to take regulatory requirements in at least one other Southeast Asian or international market (e.g., BSP, BOT, MAS, BNM, or equivalent)
• Proven experience conducting IT risk assessments, control testing, and gap analyses
• Demonstrated ability to develop, review, and maintain IT policies, standards, and procedures
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate diverse regulatory requirements into technical and operational controls
• Effective communicator who can engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders across multiple countries and time zones

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience navigating Bank Indonesia's PJP (Penyelenggara Jasa Pembayaran) Category 1 or Category 2 licensing requirements, including ongoing IT compliance obligations and regulatory examination readiness
• Hands-on experience managing end-to-end certification processes — scoping, readiness assessment, evidence preparation, auditor coordination, and post-certification surveillance — for ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, or SOC 2
• Direct experience coordinating IT audits or regulatory examinations with regional bodies such as BSP (Philippines), BOT (Thailand), MAS (Singapore), BNM (Malaysia), etc
• Relevant professional certifications such as CISA, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor
• Prior experience in fintech, digital payments, or financial services in a multi-market Southeast Asian or global context
• Exposure to cloud environments and understanding of cloud security control frameworks
• Background in working cross-functionally with engineering and product teams to embed compliance-by-design principles

Responsibilities

• Own and support Xendit's compliance programs for certification and regulatory audits, ensuring controls are implemented, tested, and evidenced effectively
• Serve as the primary GRC point of contact for regional regulatory needs, coordinating IT-related audit and examination processes with regional regulatory bodies
• Manage the full certification lifecycle for applicable frameworks — from initial scoping and gap analysis through certification issuance and ongoing surveillance — ensuring timely renewals and continuous compliance
• Conduct periodic IT risk assessments across markets, maintain a consolidated IT risk register, and track remediation activities through to closure
• Perform internal control testing and assessments to evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of IT controls across Xendit's regional entities
• Identify compliance gaps across markets and work with relevant teams to develop and execute remediation plans
• Develop, review, update, and enforce IT policies, standards, and procedures in line with multi-jurisdictional regulatory and framework requirements
• Coordinate regulatory and third-party audits end-to-end, including preparing evidence packages, managing auditor requests, and facilitating examiner meetings
• Monitor the evolving regulatory landscape across all operating markets and assess the impact of new or updated requirements on Xendit's IT environment
• Produce compliance dashboards, regional status reports, and management briefings to keep stakeholders informed of GRC posture across all markets
• Collaborate with engineering, product, security, and legal teams to embed compliance and risk considerations into project delivery and system design
• Support continuous improvement of GRC processes, tooling, and automation to scale compliance operations efficiently across a growing number of markets

About the Role

We are looking for a Facilities & Maintenance Specialist to maintain our office facilities, equipment, and building systems in optimal working order. In this hands-on role, you will perform technical repairs across AC split systems, basic electrical / plumbing / civil work setups, and general office infrastructure while coordinating regular maintenance schedules. You will work directly with internal stakeholders to understand office issues, diagnose root causes, and deliver cost-effective, practical solutions quickly

What you will do

• Technical Maintenance & Repairs: perform hands-on troubleshooting and simple repairs for AC split units, piping/plumbing systems, electrical wiring, MCB panels, and general office hardware.
• Routine Preventive Cadence: Coordinate and execute scheduled preventive maintenance cadences for office facilities, HVAC, lighting, and power infrastructure to minimize operational downtime.
• Problem Solving & Diagnostics: Assess reported facility issues, identify root causes, and implement practical short- and long-term repair solutions. Manage all maintenance tickets and requests to ensure effective and cost-efficient resolution within agreed SLAs.
• User & Stakeholder Coordination: Engage directly with office teams to understand facility complaints, communicate resolution timelines, and minimize disruption to daily operations.
• Cost & Resource Efficiency: Evaluate repair requests to recommend and execute the most cost-effective solution without compromising safety or quality.
• Vendor & Supply Management: Coordinate with external contractors or building management for specialized repairs and assist in inventory tracking for maintenance of spare parts and tools.
• Safety & Compliance: Ensure all maintenance and repair activities strictly adhere to workplace health and safety (WHS) standards and electrical safety practices.

What you will need

• Technical Experience: 2–4 years of practical, hands-on experience in office facility maintenance, building services, or technician roles.
• Core Technical Skills: Proven working knowledge and practical troubleshooting skills in plumbing, AC Split systems, refrigerant piping, basic electrical circuitry, and MCB distribution boards.
• General Handyman Proficiency: Skilled in executing simple carpentry, plumbing, lighting, and general office hardware repairs independently.
• Diagnostic & Practical Thinking: Strong capability to analyze physical facility issues on-site and execute effective, budget-conscious solutions.
• Communication & User Service: Friendly, clear, and proactive communication skills to interact with internal employees and understand office facility requests.
• Organizational Skills: Ability to prioritize urgent repair tickets, manage routine maintenance schedules, and follow up consistently.
• Vendor Oversight: Since the role involves coordinating with contractors or building management, explicitly look for experience in supervising third-party service providers.

About the Team

The Workplace & Facilities Team is responsible for creating safe, comfortable, and fully functional physical environments where our teams can do their best work. We act as the rapid-response and preventive arm that keeps our office spaces running smoothly every single day. Joining our team means taking direct ownership of office physical health, solving everyday facility challenges, and delivering high-quality, practical support across our workplaces

Job Description

Role Summary
The S&D Product Owner (Sales Execution Applications) owns the product lifecycle of IOH’s sales & distribution execution applications, covering DSE, Internal Sales, Direct Sales Agent, Promotor, Merchandiser, Partner, Retailer and Key Accounts. As the central HQ owner of the domain roadmap, requirements and delivery alignment, the role works with IT delivery and UAT Testers on quality, and with Sales Enablement so that what is built gets adopted in the field. It also turns field and system data into recommendations on how automation can make the sales force more effective.

Key Responsibilities

1. Roadmap Ownership & Management

• Develop and own the sales execution applications roadmap, based on business priorities, regional input, field insight and automation opportunities.
• Prioritize the roadmap and backlog by business impact, field readiness and delivery capacity, and manage dependencies with UI/UX, IT delivery and core systems teams.
• Decide roadmap and scope changes within the domain, and escalate items that add a new module or user group, change a business process, or affect other channels.
• Tailor solutions to differences in sales roles, employment models (direct vs. partner) and regions.

2. Requirement Definition & Detailing

• Detail requirement documents, user stories, process flows, business rules and acceptance criteria.
• Validate flows with UI/UX through wireframes and interactive prototypes before development starts.
• Align and develop business requirements for core and broader system dependencies.

3. Delivery Monitoring & UAT Governance

• Align with IT delivery on scope, timeline and quality, and escalate risks early with options.
• Provide acceptance criteria and business scenarios for UAT, and monitor progress and results against requirements and timeline.
• Decide on deviations raised during development and UAT (defects, scope gaps, workarounds, slippage) by weighing business impact against timeline, and keep requirements valid as conditions change.
• Escalate deviations that change scope, business process or go-live date, and recommend go/no-go for final sign-off.

.

4. Regional Alignment & Channel Enablement

• Lead workshops, field visits and requirement validation with regional teams, so requirements reflect regional realities before sign-off.
• Align with Sales Enablement on what is changing, why and when, so training and field communication are ready before go-live.
• Provide functional guidance to regional counterparts for consistent execution across regions.

5. Insight & Automation Recommendations

• Analyze field and system data (visit execution, coverage, productivity, adoption, compliance) to find where sales effectiveness is lost and which manual field processes can be automated.
• Assess automation opportunities by sales impact, effort saved and feasibility, build them into the roadmap, and escalate larger or cross-channel opportunities.

Qualifications & Experience

• Experience: 5–7 years in sales operations, business analysis, product ownership, or sales strategy, preferably in telecom, FMCG, or digital services, including at least 2 years owning a sales, field, or distribution application or leading cross-functional delivery.
• Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of field sales and route-to-market dynamics, proven ability to write requirement documents and acceptance criteria, and the data literacy to turn field and system data into recommendations, including where automation can improve sales effectiveness.
• Execution & Operational Discipline: Proven track record managing a product backlog, driving UAT to closure with IT and QA teams, making trade-off decisions under timeline pressure, and supporting application rollouts to field teams across regions.
• Stakeholder Management: Ability to drive alignment between HQ, regional teams, Sales Enablement, IT delivery, PQA, and UI/UX without direct authority.

Job Summary**

As a Sales Officer at PT Santosa Utama Lestari, you will be responsible for driving sales growth and achieving targets through effective client engagement, product promotion, and relationship management.

Job Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement sales strategies to acquire new customers and expand market share.
* Present and demonstrate company products/services to prospective clients.
* Negotiate and close sales deals, ensuring customer satisfaction and adherence to company policies.
* Maintain strong relationships with existing clients to foster loyalty and identify upselling opportunities.
* Prepare and submit regular sales reports, forecasts, and market analysis.
* Stay updated on industry trends, competitor activities, and product knowledge.
* Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., marketing, operations) to ensure seamless customer experience.
* Handle customer inquiries, complaints, and provide appropriate solutions.
* Participate in sales meetings, training sessions, and promotional events.

Job Qualifications**

* Min Eduction High school, Bachelor degree will be plus.
* Proven track record of success in sales, preferably within a similar industry.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong customer service orientation and ability to build rapport.
* Results-driven with a strong desire to meet and exceed sales targets.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Willingness to travel as required.

Ringkasan Pekerjaan

Sebagai Sales Officer di PT Santosa Utama Lestari, Anda akan bertanggung jawab untuk mendorong pertumbuhan penjualan dan mencapai target melalui interaksi yang efektif dengan klien, promosi produk, dan pengelolaan hubungan pelanggan.

Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan

• Mengembangkan dan menerapkan strategi penjualan untuk mendapatkan pelanggan baru dan memperluas pangsa pasar.
• Mempresentasikan dan mendemonstrasikan produk/layanan perusahaan kepada calon klien.
• Melakukan negosiasi dan menyelesaikan kesepakatan penjualan, dengan memastikan kepuasan pelanggan serta kepatuhan terhadap kebijakan perusahaan.
• Memelihara hubungan yang kuat dengan klien yang sudah ada untuk membangun loyalitas dan mengidentifikasi peluang *upselling* (penjualan tambahan).
• Menyusun dan menyerahkan laporan penjualan, prakiraan (*forecast*), dan analisis pasar secara berkala.
• Memantau tren industri, aktivitas pesaing, dan memperbarui pengetahuan produk.
• Berkolaborasi dengan tim internal (misalnya pemasaran, operasional) untuk memastikan pengalaman pelanggan yang lancar dan memuaskan.
• Menangani pertanyaan dan keluhan pelanggan, serta memberikan solusi yang tepat.
• Berpartisipasi dalam rapat penjualan, sesi pelatihan, dan acara promosi.

Kualifikasi Pekerjaan

• Minimal Pendidikan SMA/SMK, D3/S1 Menjadi nilai tambah
• Memiliki rekam jejak keberhasilan dalam bidang penjualan, lebih disukai di industri yang serupa.
• Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi, negosiasi, dan interpersonal yang sangat baik.
• Memiliki orientasi layanan pelanggan yang kuat dan kemampuan untuk membangun hubungan baik (*rapport*).
• Berorientasi pada hasil dengan keinginan kuat untuk mencapai dan melampaui target penjualan.
• Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun sebagai bagian dari tim.
• Menguasai Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
• Bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas jika diperlukan.
